title: Link batch
description: The body of one POST of the session to the events URL of its gateway's link, application/cloudevents-batch+json: events of one run, in the session's order, never empty. Each is an event of the contract without sequence, and none is an event the gateway writes: the gateway numbers the run's stream, sends the ping as the node toward the server, and writes the run's dev.qory.run.egress. A dev.qory.run.started is opened by the session, and a dev.qory.run.exited has none of the reasons the gateway writes: gateway_lost, session_lost and quiet. The gateway refuses a batch on rules the schema cannot state as well: the README's §The gateway's link lists them.

event.description: An event as event.schema.json defines it, with no sequence, and not dev.qory.ping or dev.qory.run.egress, which the gateway writes. A dev.qory.run.started has opened_by session, and a dev.qory.run.exited's reason is none of gateway_lost, session_lost and quiet.
